data.eligibility_information:
Candidates will be considered only if they do not have any active backlogs in any academic year/semester. Candidates with previous backlogs will be considered only if all backlogs have been successfully cleared and passed.

Only candidates with no active backlogs and completed academic qualifications will be eligible for consideration.
data.additional_information:
Work on research and development of onboard compute architectures, edge AI platforms, high-speed interfaces, heterogeneous compute systems, and FPGA-assisted acceleration architectures for unmanned systems. 

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES 
Research embedded compute platforms for onboard AI and autonomous systems. 
Benchmark compute-per-watt, thermal performance, and memory bandwidth behavior. 
Study heterogeneous architectures involving CPU, GPU, FPGA, and AI accelerators. 
Investigate FPGA-assisted data processing and hardware acceleration workflows. 
Analyze high-speed interfaces including PCIe, MIPI CSI, USB, and Ethernet. 
Research low-latency video and sensor processing pipelines for edge systems. 
Study Linux BSPs, boot architectures, and hardware-software integration methods. 
Support bring-up and validation of embedded compute and AI hardware platforms. 
Benchmark emerging compute platforms for airborne deployment suitability. 
Prepare architecture studies, subsystem reports, and technical documentation. 

Skills Required 

Strong understanding of embedded systems and computer architecture basics. 
Familiarity with Linux systems and hardware-software interaction concepts. 
Understanding of high-speed digital interfaces and data movement principles. 
Ability to analyze compute workloads, latency, and system bottlenecks. 
Understanding of embedded debugging and system integration concepts.

 PREFERRED SKILLS 
Exposure to NVIDIA, NXP, Qualcomm, or AMD/Xilinx platforms. 
Familiarity with FPGA concepts and hardware acceleration workflows. 
Exposure to Verilog, VHDL, or FPGA development environments. 
Familiarity with GStreamer, OpenCV, or multimedia processing pipelines. 
Exposure to CUDA, OpenCL, or AI deployment frameworks.

 QUALIFICATIONS
B.E. / B.Tech / M.Tech /PhD
data.additional_details:
Please find below the additional important details regarding our Company Clauses & Policies:

1.NDA – Non-Disclosure Agreement
Candidates must not disclose or share any confidential information related to their job role, projects, company operations, or work responsibilities with any external party. This clause will remain applicable for a lifetime.
2.NCC – Non-Compete Clause
Upon joining the company, when you decide to leave the organization in the future, you will not be eligible to join any direct competitor of the company for a period of 3 years post the last working day.
3.Minimum Service Agreement – 2 Years
Candidates from any branch having less than 2 Years of Experience are required to sign a mandatory 2-year Minimum Service Agreement. However, Candidates with more than 2 years of prior experience are exempted from the Minimum Service Agreement. Additionally breach of this agreement will result in a financial penalty of 40% of the CTC.
